approved_scope.title: A tree with source and no specs must show its coverage number and must not pass strict validation
approved_scope.description: A tree with source and no specs must show its coverage number and must not pass strict validation
acceptance_criteria: Running `specsync check` on a project with source files and an empty specs directory prints the coverage figures rather than omitting them, and `--strict` exits non-zero instead of reporting the tree clean. The machine-readable payload carries the source-file count and coverage percent so a consumer can distinguish a project with unmeasured source from an empty one. A project with no source files at all, whose specs have simply not been generated yet, continues to exit zero under `--strict`.
